1445-2292-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

728-862-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
728-862-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

229-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Endless One is in your graveyard.
229-5006-8170.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Endless One. It enters as dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat.

3490-7075-7295-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7295-7763.description:
Activate an artifact creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

728-1339-3284.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-3284.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

628-4247-7212.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4247-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

560-2438-4550-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2438-4550-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or Forensic Researcher

950-5475-7786.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

553-819-2928.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Tidal Barracuda.
In response, cast Memory Lapse by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

1263-2921-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6747-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher

1318-2743-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus an additional {3} to select its second mode, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Three Steps Ahead twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Three Steps Ahead spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-4927.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5256-6794.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5226-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5226-5702.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

57-2341-4846-6791.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon is not your commander.
57-2341-4846-6791.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1012-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

141-5686-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

4053-5499-6968--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-6968--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

3693-4613-6627-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and The Earth Crystal.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1305-1879-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

4002-4067-6100-6281.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4067-6100-6281.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat.

1247-1306-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Mana Crypt's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1550-2105-3480.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1742-6092-6186.notablePrerequisites: You are able to draw a card.
1742-6092-6186.description:
Activate Words of War by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Attempt to draw a card, with the draw being replaced by Words of War dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of War by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet ability, replacing the first card draw with Words of War dealing 2 damage to an opponent, and causing you to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 4.

539-1636-3652-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-3652-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If you control another nontoken creature without summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite mana creatures you control can produce.

3252-3809-4508-4875.description:
Activate Shivan Hellkite by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1913-4659-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
1913-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1102-2034-2178-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Steel Overseer.
Steel Overseer does not have summoning sickness.
1102-2034-2178-3490.description:
Activate Steel Overseer by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each artifact creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
The Servo dies, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping Steel Overseer.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Animation Module trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

539-2900.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature other than Quirion Ranger that does not have summoning sickness.
539-2900.description:
Activate any nontoken creature you control except Quirion Ranger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Quirion Ranger by returning itself from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the creature tapped for mana.
Cast Quirion Ranger by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1017-2541.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
You have a way to draw a card.
1017-2541.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

1436-3007-5261.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-3007-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-3007-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Toymaker.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

618-2059.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

802-1846-2493.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four untapped Islands.
802-1846-2493.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, causing Islands to add an additional {U} this turn.
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, causing Islands to add an additional {U} this turn.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two Islands.
Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding six {U}.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 8.
